notes.title: hotfix 25.13.8
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3][/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing interaction with death chests at Oxygen Stations.
[*] Fixed multiple bugs causing tool modifications to break and stop working with tools.
[*] Fixed environment bugs that made some Mox Credit boxes unreachable.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing Habitat Solar Panels from being built on Small Circle Rooms.
[*] Fixed an issue where the T4 Storage Module for the Seeker wouldn’t install; rebuilding the Seeker will resolve this bug.
[*] Fixed a bug causing Nanite Battery and Powercell textures to revert on chargers.
[*] Fixed a bug where items would disappear when attempting to pick them up with a full inventory.
[*] Fixed an issue where the storage box in the starting location didn’t detect the last row of items from the fabricator.
[*] Fixed a bug causing the Docking Station to temporarily hide markers.
[*] Fixed a bug where base colors would reset after loading or warping.
[*] Fixed a bug causing T1 and T3 blueprint boxes to keep respawning in secret areas.
[*] Fixed an issue causing consumables to keep spawning in the Ceta Control Center.
[/list]

[b][h3]Additions:[/h3][/b]

[list]
[*] You can now teleport vehicles inside Docking Station.
[*] The flashlight will now automatically turn off when gravity changes (to help players who forget to turn it off when returning to base).
[*] Added new secrets in Theta-9 and Theta-12.
[*] Save system improvements.
[*] Performance Improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Astrometica - Update Delay & What’s New
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Hey everyone,[/h3][/b]

We wanted to give you an important update on the status of the upcoming content update. As you have noticed, we weren’t able to release the update today, and we want to be transparent about why — and what’s coming.

[h3]🚧 Why the Delay?[/h3]
The truth is: this update became much bigger than we originally planned. We made some major balancing changes and introduced new systems, which led us to build an entirely new asteroid belt — with many new points of interest and brand-new stories.

We don’t want to release an unpolished experience. Our top priority is delivering a smooth and meaningful update. That’s why we’ve made the decision to delay — just a little longer. We’ll be doing a “shadow drop” soon once we’re confident everything works as it should.

[h3]🪐 A Massive Leap in Content[/h3]
So how big is this update?

[list]
[*] [h3]Nearly 3x more content than the current Early Access version.[/h3]
[*] [h3]Theta-9 asteroid belt now has 2x more locations than before.[/h3]
[*] [h3]Introducing Theta-12, a brand-new asteroid belt — bigger than Theta-9.[/h3]
[*] [h3]More than 80 new resources, tool modifications and Items.[/h3]
[*] [h3]Over 25 new original soundtracks, most of which are for Theta-12.[/h3]
[*] [h3]Huge visual overhaul and new lighting systems.[/h3]
[*] [h3]Tons of new secrets, challenges, and mechanics.[/h3]
[/list]

[h3]💡 What’s Holding It Back?[/h3]
We had to rebalance large parts of the game from scratch, which naturally takes time. On top of that, our 3D artist faced health issues over the past couple of weeks, which impacted the creation of essential assets and props.

notes.title: Patch 0.99.24.13
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
We're back with a fresh update featuring bug fixes, improvements, and a few new additions to enhance your experience. Here's what's new:

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Summon vehicle vanishing bug fixed when using the unstuck button or when the player dies while in the vehicle.
[*] Lighting bug in the vertical station fixed.
[*] Stair corridor collision improvements made.
[*] Christmas lights can now be deconstructed from all angles (specific side/angle bug fixed).
[*] Fixed a bug where pinned blueprints appeared on the screen after crafting tool modifications.
[*] Issue with players unable to take tool modification cards from the machine fixed.
[*] Battery swapping bug during tool usage fixed.
[*] Pinned blueprints in tool modification now correctly unpin.
[*] Fixed an issue where X and stair corridors didn’t return resources after loading the game.
[*] Recycled tools now no longer provide empty batteries when the tool itself didn’t have a battery.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused build signs to duplicate.
[*] Fixed an issue where crafting a modification in a full inventory caused issues with retrieval.
[*] Fixed a bug causing oxygen loss during photo mode while in the summon vehicle.
[*] FOV settings now persist after loading the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where adding power cells to the hook tool was causing problems.
[*] Beacons can now be correctly placed in the research outpost island.
[*] Lighting in the red cave improved and bugs fixed.
